verdict_rationale: The authors' unmodified S2.R, run in Docker on Zenodo v2 with the README pins, reproduced every code-generated value to machine precision: S3 1601/1601, Fig. 3 labels 128/128 with bar order, and Table 2 18/18. The exception is 8 of 130 Table 1 cells, which the paper's own deposited S1/S3 show to be a paper error. All named values and Table 3 match. The remaining items are a cosmetic stack-order convention (T02) and an unsourced map layer (T14). Conclusions confirmed. Coverage is 12/15; the verdict is conditional on human confirmation of the PAPER_ERROR (T04, T08 text) and CANNOT_COMPARE (T14) calls.

targets.failure_mode: The Fig. 5 coloured patches ('known extent of each individual motif') are a substantive data layer with no stated source, code, or deposited input (data unavailability for that component), so the figure cannot be compared in full.
targets.notes: Testable components match: pie compositions 10/10 (R1 S1 lookup), and relative positions are consistent (comparisons/aids/fig5-object-positions-aid.png). The motif-extent patches cannot be compared. Escalated for human confirmation.

S3 deposit vs reproduced Part 8 CSVs, joined on the motif tuple. Row membership is identical (165/106/20), row order is identical, and all 1601 numeric cells are equal (max abs diff 0). Membership: comparisons/results/t15-s3-membership.csv.

escalations.detail: Table 1 n values differ by 1 in 8 cells (bigrams at frequencies 8/7/4/3/2/1; trigrams at 2/1). The deposited S3 (authors' Part 8 output) supports the reproduction at bigram frequencies 3/4/7/8 (60/31/9/5). Sum of C(m,2) and C(m,3) over S1 Total gives 2513/4961 occurrences, equal to the reproduction; Table 1 implies 2516/4962. Totals and conclusions are unaffected. Possible cause: transcription, or a table produced from an earlier data state (methods cite Zenodo v1, not used per AP-12).

The Section 3 text says nine salient bigrams are unique to the Ertebølle period but names only eight. The reproduction confirms nine; the omitted bigram is C5-C12 (3 objects, all Ertebølle, PMI 2.1890, visible in Fig. 3b). Scored against the stated counts (R4), so T08 is EXACT_MATCH; the list error is for human confirmation.

The Fig. 5 motif-extent patches have no stated source or deposited input. Pie compositions (10/10) and relative positions match via R1 aids. Confirm CANNOT_COMPARE, or reclassify if the patches are judged cartographic rather than scientific content.

Published Fig. 4 boxes also mark many cells with observed <= 2 (no PMI fill). The approved aid (createResultTable on observed > 2) covers only 32 cells, all matching. The planning assumption was incomplete; decide whether a documented deviation or a further check is needed. No scope was changed by the executor.
